summary: Session 1 of 2 — Stale-Artifact Refresh. NO classifier/usage logic changed (that shipped in set 001). (1) Confirmed fresh cleanup behavior: identify-cleanup --no-com => 0 findings for both HomeHealthCare and NorthwindDevEdition (matches the spec premise). A COM-backed run was also exercised (spec's stated preference): NorthwindDevEdition 0; HomeHealthCare 3 DateSignal findings — tblClientServicePlan (288d) and tblClients (293d) are legitimate stale-vs-fresh, but tblClientServiceNeeds reports MAX DateTime 1899-12-30 (the Access/OLE zero-date = a time-only DateTime column with no date part) as ~46176 days stale, which looks wrong (a heuristic misfire), not merely stale. Two cross-provider consensus rounds (gpt-5-4 + gemini-pro) were unanimous, the maintainer was consulted (HomeHealthCare is synthetic so its dates are fabricated; NorthwindDevEdition is proprietary with a gitignored .accdb so a COM golden can't be reproduced from a clone), and the deliberate decision was to commit the deterministic --no-com goldens and surface the 1899-12-30 misfire to the maintainer per the spec stop rule rather than fix it here. (2) Regenerated object-cleanup.json + object-cleanup-checklist.json for both fixtures via --no-com (harvest-date 2026-06-05), LF-normalized with the BOM preserved; both now carry findings: [] (no CrossReferenceAbsence, no launcher/parameter false positives); confirmed via grep. (3) Removed the dead CrossReferenceDetector.cs + CrossReferenceDetectorTests.cs (zero production callers; CleanupAnalyser uses only NamePatternDetector + DateSignal). Retained the CrossReferenceAbsenceSignal type, its CleanupChecklistWriter switch arm, and the object-cleanup-schema enum per the spec's conservative guard (still cross-referenced; removing the schema enum is a consumer-contract change out of scope). The negative-assertion pin CleanupAnalyserTests.Run_Does_Not_Emit_CrossReferenceOnly_Findings is retained. (4) Refreshed docs/planning/harvester-upstream-feedback.md with a dated Resolution Status (2026-06-05) table marking all 5 items addressed with shipping set + grounded evidence pointers (all cited signal identifiers verified present in code), plus a deferred-observation note for the 1899-12-30 zero-date misfire; original feedback content retained verbatim. (5) Build/test sequential: dotnet build AccessHarvester.sln => 0 errors; Pipeline.Tests Cleanup slice 48/48; full Pipeline.Tests (excl. COM probe) 789/789. Swept spurious samples/*.accdb timestamp churn before staging. Cross-provider verification (gpt-5-4) R1 VERIFIED, empty issues. Separately surfaced to the maintainer (out of scope for this set): ~406 NorthwindDevEdition derived-metadata files are committed to GitHub despite the proprietary policy.
